convert_panoptic_to_semantic: run the script to convert COCO panoptic segmentation annotations to semantic segmentation annotations
process_single_panoptic_image: create a function that converts a single panoptic PNG image to a semantic segmentation mask using category ID mapping
separate_semantic_from_panoptic: build a multiprocessing pipeline that creates semantic segmentation annotations from COCO panoptic segmentation JSON and PNG files
review_COCO_CATEGORIES: review the COCO_CATEGORIES list containing 133 category definitions with colors, IDs, names, and thing versus stuff flags
parse_coco_path_args: create an argparse CLI that accepts a COCO dataset path for converting panoptic to semantic annotations
